ADD THE KIND AND ROTATE EVERY DIGEST MIRROR. Insert `project.set_agent_provider` into RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS in packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts at the sorted slot (after `project.register`, before `provider.probe` unless step 1 measured different neighbours). Do not add it to RUNTIME_QUERY_KINDS or RUNTIME_TELEMETRY_KINDS. Run `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate` (never hand-edit generated-client.ts). Quote OLD and NEW GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST in the step note. Update generated-coverage.test.ts GENERATED_FILE_SHA256 (sha256 of the new generated-client.ts bytes) and CONTRACT_DIGEST to the NEW digest. Update every remaining hardcoded mirror, currently expected: apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/approve-plan.test.tsx:255 and apps/control-room/src/data/data-adapter.test.ts:18. data-adapter.test.ts currently holds a different hash (foreign WIP) — change only the contractSchemaHash string, do not revert other dirt in that file. scripts/release/release-subject.mjs derives; do not edit it. VERIFY AND ADVERSARIAL. Run each leg standalone and foreground; quote `Test Files N passed` (global rail 8 — exit 0 with no count line is a vacuous run). Legs: `pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` (the two apps/control-room mirrors hard-throw and are in NONE of the other usual gates), `pnpm test` (root lane is real evidence here), `pnpm typecheck`. Adversarial: (1) drop the kind from RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS but leave EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS — the toEqual arm goes RED. (2) drop it from EXPECTED_COMMAND_KINDS only — same arm RED. (3) insert it in the tuple at the wrong sorted slot — the sorted-position test AND the neighbour pin go RED. Restore tracked paths via git diff; if generated-client.ts is untracked (should be tracked), SHA256 vs %TEMP% per rail 13. Confirm no daemon file and no second provider-name roster landed. Then complete_task.
